newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar drifts lower, could fall further.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar drifts lower, could fall further.

text.p: London's white sugar futures market maintained its recent bearish tone on Monday in a light start to the week's trading with little actual volume posted.
The session's turnover was dominated by a large "against actuals' trade in the spot December contract, boosted by a trade house crossed deal.
Light outright buying was also noted in December, along with sales of the second-month March position, where the market's open interest is centred.
At 1218 GMT December was down 30 cents at $306.50, $1.00 off its session low. March was down 70 cents at $305.00 and total volume amounted to 502 lots.
Traders said there was room for nearby contracts to move further to the downside.

In fundamental news, Costa Rica recently sold 40,000 tonnes of raw sugar for shipment in the first half of 1997. One shipment was of 15,000 tonnes for February/March with a further 25,000 tonnes to be shipped for March/May.
Both were sold at premiums of 15 points over New York's benchmark March contract.Details of the buyers have yet to emerge.
